text: hey everybody I posted a video this morning that stitched a Creator who purported to offer proof of Noah's flood but who also spoke at a very high volume
and that struck me initially as something being done for rhetorical effects so I didn't think anything of the implications of posting that
stitched video now predictably the overwhelming majority of the comments focused on the volume of that Creator's voice and some helpful commenters
pointed out that that is most likely the result of a condition that that creator has and I didn't know that such
conditions existed but I went and looked at other videos of theirs from a handful of different social media platforms and
I couldn't find a single video in which they were not speaking at a very high volume so it does seem most likely to me that that is the case for this Creator
and in light of that I grew increasingly uncomfortable with the number of comments that were coming in that were focused on the volume of their voice and
this is not to criticize anyone who did comment on the volume of their voice but
I took the video down I want this to be a place where we can speak truth to power and focus on the data and be
analytical but also where we can be respectful and compassionate and that is not to say that things can't get chippy
in the comments I don't have an issue with that but when it comes to a condition like this I just don't want to
be the facilitator of that kind of thing so I appreciate the conscientiousness of the people who pointed that out to me I
apologize to this Creator I'm not going to tag them because I don't want to bring more attention to their account I
apologize to those in the audience who may have felt targeted or attacked or in any way may have been affected by the
many comments that were posted on the video and I apologize to those who may have posted thoughtful comments on that video that are now gone this is on me I
will educate hate myself about this condition I will work on being more conscientious about behavior and videos
that I Stitch and in short I will try to do better in the future
